description: This file defines an immutable data object `LoanDueData` used to represent the state and charges associated with a loan that is due within the financial application, including information like amounts due, paid, and loan identifiers.

classes.name: LoanDueData
classes.description: Immutable data object for representing loan with dues, encapsulating loan identifiers, status, product info, currency, and various amount fields related to disbursement and dues.

methods.name: LoanDueData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields related to a loan's due data, calculating total due as the sum of principal, interest, and charges.

methods.name: getLoanId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the loan.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account identifier associated with the loan.

methods.name: getAccountStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status ID of the loan account.

methods.name: getProductShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name or code for the loan product.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the loan product.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with the loan.

methods.name: getDisbursementAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount disbursed for this loan.

methods.name: getChargesDue
methods.description: Returns the amount of charges due.
